def: A pure check on a system's output, with no randomness or model call, that returns pass or fail with a reason.
One input together with the checks or reference answer that define correct behaviour for it.
A program that runs test cases against a system, applies checks, stores results and compares runs.
A test that checks a relationship between outputs on related inputs, such as unchanged answers under rephrasing.
A release rule that blocks a change if a case that passed before now fails.
A small, fast subset of the most important test cases, run on every change.
Test cases kept out of prompts, examples and training data so they measure generalisation.
